root_cause_and_fix.initial_attempt: The inherited Astro process had PUBLIC_CONTENT_MANAGER_SCOPE=breslov_e2e while the worker was explicitly primary, so the UI-created job remained queued and was not claimed.
root_cause_and_fix.minimal_fix: Restarted Astro with PUBLIC_CONTENT_MANAGER_SCOPE=breslov_primary and restarted the DEV backend/worker through canonical launchers with explicit primary scope and persistent DEV storage.
